scope: 10 mm pitch seed for a rounded finite variant; same analytic threshold and phase, independent separation and containment checks required
reason_for_geometric_margin: Reserve a 0.20 mm inward construction buffer for G1 rounding; actual containment must still be checked without tolerance relaxation
normalization: one fixed as_original().simplify(0) before export; retain exact final oriented-triangle roundtrip
cap_distance_crosscheck: Independently construct convex-combination witnesses on candidate triangle edges/interior; if that candidate fails, search every clip triangle. A witness within the unchanged cap threshold proves proximity, even when libigl selected the wrong skinny triangle.
sphere_controls_method: Native level_set of signed sphere distance using tolerance=1e-5, identical root-refinement setting to the finite gyroid; recomputed on every call.

smoothing.cleanup_role: Intentional 1 micrometre geometry simplification after G1 interpolation, followed by fixed materialization and an exact final transfer check; mass is recomputed.
smoothing.binary_grid_role: Explicit sub-nanometre coordinate regularization before native ingestion; maximum component movement is half a grid step. Final exact transfer, containment and separation checks remain required.
smoothing.post_rounding_component_rule: Retain the largest positive connected void component per field sign; fill other positive pockets with material and refuse negative cavity shells.
